senses.definition: One who counts.

senses.definition: An object (now especially a small disc) used in counting or keeping count, or as a marker in games, etc.
examples: He rolled a six on the dice, so moved his counter forward six spaces.

senses.definition: A telltale; a contrivance attached to an engine, printing press, or other machine, for the purpose of counting the revolutions or the pulsations.

examples: He put his money on the counter, and the shopkeeper put it in the till.

senses.definition: A shop tabletop on which goods are examined, weighed or measured.

(historical) The prison attached to a city court; a compter.
